v1_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Events outside of working hours shouldn't conflict the scheduling algorithm
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_2: The order of events should not affect the correctness
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_3: No meeting may start during the lunch break
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_4: The new meeting's end time can not be v2_human 5
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_5: The new meetings start time can not be v1_human 9
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_6: The event can not be booked (the suggestion can not be) at a time that overlaps with a different meeting

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: Should find all the time slots that work for the meeting
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: Should not suggest overlapping event starts
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: Events should not be scheduled during lunch break

v1_human_g3_goal: It is a meeting scheduling system that finds slots where a meeting can be scheduled based on its duration, day, and start time & end time. Other constraints like how many a day is available for meetings will also be considered.
v1_human_g3_input: meetings duration: integer for length of meeting in minutes; day: a string for the day of the week; events: A list of events. Each event is an object with a start time and end time.

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_1: The list of meetings should not have overlapping events and all events in the list should always be valid

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: Meeting can never overlap with existing events
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: meeting can never be booked v2_human 5.

v1_human_g3_output: It returns a list of valid start times as 'HH:MM' sorted in ascending order.
